captions.text: B : « Je ne peux pas tout porter. »

shoe_layer.note: k 0-95: wide layer (L-S4 push-in vs E-S3 static wide: same file, different camera, so the screen raster differs by the push-in only); k 96-149: hi layer in the identical close camera (L-S5 = E-S4 as a function of time since the cut), screen raster byte-identical before the whole-pixel water-level translation dy_screen = round(m * dy_world), which rides each version's own water level.

declared: edit-r2: the E-S3/E-S4 and E-S4/E-S5 cuts are 0.5 s later than plan section 6 (50.5 and 52.9 instead of 50.0 and 52.4) so that E-S4 starts at the same shoe-layer frame and the same time before the hand-off as L-S5; E-S5 is 1.6 s (the rewrite is written faster); E-S6 and every other cut are as planned. The film-to-local offset of E is unchanged (39.5 s).

edit-r2: the L-S5/E-S4 close opens on the hand-off with both heads in frame and tilts down with B's kneel to the plank-foot framing; the heart leaf that hid the receiver is removed from the near dressing; a buttress flange (Buttress Roots 1, CC BY-SA 4.0) stands as a P1 plane behind the hand-off.
edit-r2: charcoal mud and sweat glints are laid on faces and mittens by the editor's wet pass (handmade make-up on the card puppets); the shoe is never touched by it.
edit-r2: the splash on the last crosser's shins is a handmade cut-paper water sheet and card droplets, animated on twos from the minimum-clearance frame of the trace.

E-S1/E-S2 show the L frames (byte-identical, plan section 6). U2's E trace differs there (C 10 px left, water 2 px lower); the E world takes over at the cut into E-S3 (45.5 s), after the ledger insert.
The ledger inserts are hands only: in L the strike and rewrite are made by B's free left hand (A has crossed), in E by A's free left hand.
The shoe's dryness and whiteness is the one declared impossibility.
